linkedin:
Remote signing should not strand a workshop participant on the approval screen.

We repaired the mobile Nostr Connect path in our LABITCONF workshop. Participants can now scan a QR code or open a link in a compatible signer, approve the connection, then work through profile, publishing, follows, trust graph and event archive exercises in one guided flow.

This is a workshop tool, not a claim that every NIP-46 signer behaves identically. Your signer still controls each requested approval.

Where does remote signing become hardest to explain in a live workshop?
